name: Fliki
tagline: Turn scripts and text into videos with AI voiceovers.
shortDescription: AI tool for turning text, scripts and ideas into videos with AI voiceovers.
description: Fliki is a web-based AI tool for creating videos from text. You provide a script or idea, and it helps assemble scenes with visuals and an AI-generated voiceover.
It is popular with creators who want to produce short social videos or explainer clips without recording their own voice or filming footage.
Free plan limits, export quality and watermarking are important details for video tools — check the current terms on the official website.

pricing.notes: Demo profile: plan names and prices have not been recorded yet. Check the official website for current pricing.

keyFeatures.title: Text to video
keyFeatures.description: Builds video scenes from a script or text input.

keyFeatures.title: AI voiceovers
keyFeatures.description: Generates narration from text using AI voices.

keyFeatures.title: Browser-based editor
keyFeatures.description: Edit scenes, timing and media in the browser — no software install.

howItWorks: Sign up on the official website.
Start a new project from a script, idea or existing text.
Choose a voice and adjust scenes and visuals.
Preview, then export the video for your platform.
bestFor: Creators making faceless or narrated videos
notIdealFor: Projects needing a real human presenter on camera
pros: A free plan is available to try the workflow
Combines visuals and voiceover in one tool
cons: Check free plan limits, watermarks and export quality
AI voices may not suit every brand
Stock media licensing terms should be reviewed for commercial use

checklist: Time to produce a 60-second video from a 150-word script
Naturalness of AI voices in English (US, UK, Indian and Australian accents if offered)
Free plan export limits and watermark on the date of testing
Licensing terms for included stock media

faqs.q: Does Fliki have a free plan?
faqs.a: Fliki lists a free plan. Check the official pricing page for current limits such as minutes, export quality and watermarks.

faqs.q: Can I use Fliki videos commercially?
faqs.a: Commercial use may depend on your plan and on stock media licences. Read Fliki's current terms before publishing commercial content.
